full_judgment: 11. Admittedly, the original suit jote measuring 5.72 acres of land including the suit land measuring .44 acres of land of B.R.S Plot No. 1088 corresponding to C.S. Plot No. 666 and R. S and S.A. Plot No. 469 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 99 (Ext. 1 ) previously belonged to one Miajan @ Miachand Chowkidar and he died leaving wife Manijan, son Bahar Ali and daughter, Joygun Bibi and Manijan died leaving Bahar Ali Chowkidar and Joygun Bibi as son and daughter respectively. It is also an admitted fact that Bahar Ali thereafter sold out .44 decimals of land of C.S. Plot No. 666 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 99 to one Shafizuddin Sarder, the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs by a registered deed in the year, 1923 A.D. (Ext. 7). The R.S. Khatian No. 187, marked Ext. 2, corresponding to C.S. Khatian No. 99 shows that the lands of the original suit jote with an area of 5.75 acres were recorded in the names of the riyots with their specific share in the jote and in the "remark column" it is mentioned that the plot No. 469 with an area of .44 decimals was being possessed by one Shafizuddin Sarder son of Tither Ali Sarder on the basis of purchase. In Ext. 2, against all other plots, names of the respective possessors were also mentioned showing their respective share in each of the pion. Ext. 3 is the S. A. Khatian No, 210 which relates to 3.83 acres of land including the suit land measuring .44 decimals of plot No. 469 wherein against suit plot No. 469 exclusive possession of Shafiz Ali @ Shafizuddin, the predecessor of the plaintiffs has been mentioned in its entire .44 decimals of land. Rent receipt Ext. 5 shows that An Sarder (plaintiff No. 1) son of Shafizuddin paid rent for the suit land in respect of Plot No. 469 appertaining to Khatian No. 210 upto 1397 B.S. The BRS Khatian No. 282 marked Ext. 6 shows that this khatian stands prepared exclusively in respect of only suit Plot No. 1088 with an area of 44 decimals which is admitted to have been finally published in the meantime. Ext. 6 appears to have been recorded in the names of both the plaintiffs and the defendants. Plaintiffs asserted through a registered deed executed in the year 1923 marked Ext. 7 that by this deed Bahar Ali Chowkidar, who had admittedly 2/3rd share in the original suit' jote, sold out 44 decimals of land in R.S. Plot No. 469 corresponding to C.S. Plot No. 666 which has subsequently been transformed into BRS plot No. 1088 to Shafizuddin Sirder, the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs . From R.S. Khatian, marked as Ext. 2, it appears that the share of all the co-sharer-tenants has been specifically mentioned therein against their names along with their individual and specific possession in each plot of the jote wherein in 'remark column' exclusive possession of Shafizuddin Sarder predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs in .44 decimals of land of R.S. Plot No. 469, on the basis of purchase, stands mentioned: The facts dis-closed in the Ext. 2 give rise to presumption that there was at amicable partition amongst the co-sharers of the C.S. jote before the preparation of the R.S. record which reflects in the R.S. Khatian No. 187 (Ext. 2). Had there been no such amicable partition the specific share of each of the co-sharer tenants with their specific possession along with specific possession of the transferees from them in each individual plot of the suit jote would not reflect in R.S. Khatian (Ext. 2). In S.A. Khatian No. 210, marked. Ext. 3, too the exclusive possession of the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs has been mentioned in .44 decimals of land of Plot No. 469.
